choose_valid_gregorian_dates_in_order_co: Choose valid Gregorian dates in order, covering no more than 366 days.
the_report_could_not_be_loaded_retry_the: The report could not be loaded. Retry the report.
period_activity_and_current_outstanding_: Period activity and current outstanding work for
gregorian_dates_africa_addis_ababa_both_: Gregorian dates · Africa/Addis_Ababa · Both dates included, up to 366 days. Each successful report read is recorded.
choose_your_dates_and_run_a_report_only_: Choose your dates and run a report. Only sections available to your role will appear.
period_activity_uses_the_selected_dates_: Period activity uses the selected dates. Current outstanding work and stock reflect this generation time, regardless of those dates.
opening_and_closure_are_counted_independ: Opening and closure are counted independently by their own timestamps. Amendments and corrections count recorded changes, including changes after closure.
investigations_exclude_reviewed_or_cance: Investigations exclude reviewed or cancelled orders. Partial prescription supply remains pending. Corrected-result reviews include closed visits and count the latest correction awaiting review.
counted_once_per_receipt_by_payment_reco: Counted once per receipt by payment recording time. These are recorded collections, not revenue, bank reconciliation or tax reporting. Legacy demonstration payments are excluded.
refunds_and_reversals_in_selected_period: Refunds and reversals in selected period
credits_and_discounts_in_selected_period: Credits and discounts in selected period
net_catalog_invoices_less_net_recorded_p: Net catalog invoices less net recorded payments, after credits and refunds, excluding void invoices. This includes collectible balances after clinical closure.
whole_base_units_per_product_different_u: Whole base units per product; different units are never added together. Current eligibility uses Addis Ababa date
exclusions_are_separate_categories_inact: . Exclusions are separate categories: inactive product first, then quarantine, expired, expiry today, or available.
no_products_on_this_page_return_to_the_p: No products on this page. Return to the previous page.
returned_units_stay_outside_usable_stock: Returned units stay outside usable stock while quarantined. Authorized restock movements are included in received stock; they are shown here for lineage and are not added again.
net_movement_received_supplied_signed_ad: Net movement = received − supplied + signed adjustments. Cancelling a prescription remainder does not return supplied stock.
each_page_is_a_new_audited_snapshot_stoc: Each page is a new audited snapshot. Stock may change between pages.
